source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of economic disparities (PDF 183).

blocks.text: Digital divide ke economic (paise aur rozgar se jure) asar bhi bare hain. Aaj ki economy mein bohat si naukriyon ke liye kam az kam basic (shuru ki, aam) digital skills chahiyein. Jin logon ke paas technology ya internet nahi, unhein naukri milna mushkil hota hai, aur pehle se peeche reh jane wali communities mein unemployment (berozgari, yaani naukri na hona) aur barh jati hai.

Misal: Pakistan mein online job portals (naukri ki websites) aur digital banking services aksar sirf urban (shehri) ilaqon ke logon tak limited hain, jis se shehri aur rural (dehaati) logon ke darmiyan paise ka faasla aur barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek tareeqa bataiye jis se digital divide paise ka faasla (economic gap) barhata hai.
blocks.explanation: Jis ke paas internet nahi woh online job portals par apply nahi kar sakta aur digital banking istemal nahi kar sakta, is liye woh naukriyon aur paise ki services (jaise bank) se mehroom reh jata hai.

items: Economic farq: naukriyon ke liye digital skills zaroori; online job portals aur digital banking zyada tar shehron tak.
